newsitem.title: USA: Grand Premier sees pretax loss on sale.
newsitem.headline: Grand Premier sees pretax loss on sale.

text.p: Grand Premier Financial Inc said Tuesday it intends to sell property once earmarked for future expansion at current fair value and take a before tax loss of about $2.2 million on the transaction.

In addition, the company's Grand Premier Operating Systems Inc operating subsidiary expects to relocate to its new Vernon Hills, Ill. facility during the fourth quarter as part of a consolidation move. Expenses associated with the move are expected to be about $250,000.
Grand Premier said the property it plans to sell is in Riverwoods, Ill. It no longer has plans to develop this land.
Earlier, Grand Premier Financial reported third-quarter earnings of $2.1 million or $0.09 per share.
